newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends flat, mkt awaits mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends flat, mkt awaits mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real closed steady at 1.0642 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market with players awaiting a decline of 0.1 percent in the reais-dollar mini-band on Tuesday, dealers said.
The current mini-band was set by the Central Bank on April 30 at between 1.0635 and 1.0685 reais per dollar.
The real was traded at around 1.0645 per dollar throughout the day due to expectations of a decline in the mini-band.
Because the Central Bank did not lower the mini-band today, the local currency recovered some ground and expectations for a decline were pushed forward to Tuesday, dealers said.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0685 per greenback, up 0.03 percent.
In the parallel market, the real rose 0.44 percent to end at 1.130 per dollar, traders said.
